name: 09-compute-host-2
title: The second compute host
description: Take kvm-02 from cloud-init Ubuntu to a CloudStack-ready nested hypervisor: verify the nested-virtualisation chain held, hand netplan ownership from cloud-init to the three-bridge CloudStack layout (cloudbr0 management on this host's own per-host address, cloudbr1 guest trunk, cloudbr2 public, storage NIC left plain for jumbo librbd traffic), install the 4.22 agent with the Ceph-profile QEMU RBD driver, and prepare the lab-only root-SSH handshake for the UI wizard host-add route.
source: Generated from runbooks/lab/lab-kvm-02.yaml in the MatrixClaw lab repository. That runbook built this phase of the real 32 GB estate on 20-21 July 2026; the run records hold every command's exit code and output.
honesty: Steps change this machine and are gated. Each carries an 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what is done rather than repeating it. Checks are read-only and carry exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text.

steps.title: Secrets file present
steps.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && test -n "$MC_KVM_ROOT_PASS"' && test "$(sudo stat -c %a /root/.mc-secrets.env)" = 600 && echo SECRETS-PRESENT-OK
steps.advice:
This phase needs /root/.mc-secrets.env on this host, mode 600, owned by root.
It is not in the repository and never will be: it holds passwords, and neither
a package nor a run record is a place for those.

Create it yourself on the target host, with values of your own choosing:

    sudo install -m 600 /dev/null /root/.mc-secrets.env
    sudo tee /root/.mc-secrets.env >/dev/null <<'ENV'
    MC_KVM_ROOT_PASS='<the same password you set on kvm-01>'
    ENV

This phase needs: MC_KVM_ROOT_PASS - each one non-empty.

Beware quoting. A value containing an apostrophe will terminate its own
single-quoted string and silently swallow the following line, leaving
every variable empty while the file still looks fine. Alphanumeric
values avoid the problem entirely.

Then run this phase again. Nothing has been changed on this host.

steps.title: Apt baseline
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y -q chrony gnupg wget bridge-utils && sudo systemctl enable --now chrony
steps.already: systemctl is-active chrony >/dev/null 2>&1 && dpkg -s bridge-utils 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed

steps.title: Verify nested chain
steps.run: test "$(egrep -c '(vmx|svm)' /proc/cpuinfo)" -ge 1 && test -e /dev/kvm && echo NESTED-CHAIN-OK || (echo 'FATAL: vmx/svm or /dev/kvm missing in the nested VM - fix lab-host nesting and the Phase 3 host-passthrough, then re-plan' && exit 1)

steps.title: Disable cloudinit network
steps.run:
sudo tee /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-disable-network-config.cfg > /dev/null << 'EOF'
network: {config: disabled}
EOF
echo CLOUDINIT-NET-DISABLED

steps.title: Cloudbr netplan
steps.run:
sudo tee /etc/netplan/60-cloudstack.yaml > /dev/null << 'EOF'
network:
  version: 2
  ethernets:
    enp1s0: {}
    enp2s0:
      addresses: [{{stg_ip}}/24]
      mtu: 9000
    enp3s0: {}
    enp4s0: {}
  bridges:
    cloudbr0:
      interfaces: [enp1s0]
      addresses: [{{mgmt_ip}}/24]
      routes: [{to: default, via: 10.100.99.1}]
      nameservers: {addresses: [1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8]}
    cloudbr1:
      interfaces: [enp3s0]
    cloudbr2:
      interfaces: [enp4s0]
EOF
sudo chmod 600 /etc/netplan/60-cloudstack.yaml
sudo rm -f /etc/netplan/50-cloud-init.yaml
sudo netplan apply

steps.title: Cloudstack apt repo
steps.run: sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings && wget -qO- https://download.cloudstack.org/release.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/cloudstack.gpg && echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/cloudstack.gpg] https://download.cloudstack.org/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) 4.22" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudstack.list && sudo apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update -q

steps.title: Agent and ceph packages
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y -q cloudstack-agent qemu-block-extra ceph-common
steps.already: dpkg -s cloudstack-agent 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s qemu-block-extra 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s ceph-common 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed

steps.title: Root password for host add
steps.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && echo "root:$MC_KVM_ROOT_PASS" | chpasswd' && echo ROOT-PASSWORD-SET

steps.title: Permit root login labonly
steps.run: echo 'PermitRootLogin yes' | sudo tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-cloudstack-lab.conf && sudo systemctl restart ssh

checks.title: Cloudbr1 up
checks.run: ip -br link show cloudbr1 | grep -o cloudbr1

checks.title: Cloudbr2 up
checks.run: ip -br link show cloudbr2 | grep -o cloudbr2

checks.title: Agent package installed
checks.run: dpkg -s cloudstack-agent 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && echo cloudstack-agent

checks.title: Rbd driver present
checks.run: dpkg -s qemu-block-extra 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s ceph-common 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && echo CEPH-PROFILE-PACKAGES-OK
